info.title: Krunker API
info.summary: The Krunker.io developer API, the game's public endpoints and the token bound ones, as krapio wraps them
info.description: Generated from the krapio source and docs. The developer API is the official one from FRVR and needs an API key; the game and token tiers are the endpoints the game itself reads, documented from observation. Full docs: https://github.com/NullDev/krapio

servers.description: developer API and most game endpoints
the old rest api and the ranked api

tags.name: developer/events
tags.description:
Events tell you when something happens on Krunker, such as a map being featured. You can poll for them, or have them pushed to a webhook (below). Both use the same events.

Each event type belongs to one **events scope**. A key only sees the types whose scope it holds; ask for a scope from the partner portal.

| Type | Scope | Sent when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `map.featured` | `events.maps` | A map was featured |
| `map.unfeatured` | `events.maps` | A map is no longer featured |

Every key with the scope gets the event. Events are kept for 30 days.

tags.name: game/players
tags.description: The social profile popup and its tabs.

tags.name: game/clans
tags.description: The in-game clan window and the recruitment board.

tags.name: game/turf
tags.description: `https://gapi.svc.krunker.io/territorial-wars/*`. Days are whole UTC days since the season epoch `2026-03-17` (`TURF_EPOCH_UTC`, `turfDay(date)` in krapio). `map_id` is the Turf map: 0 Burg, 2 Sandstorm, 3 Subzero (`TURF_MAPS`). Leaderboards return 100 rows, `kd` is a float.

tags.name: game/leaderboards
tags.description: GET /leaderboards/*: player, clan, raid and KrunkCup boards

tags.name: game/game
tags.description: Static data the page loads at start, and the community map and mod records.

tags.name: game/market
tags.description: The reads of the market tab that answer without a token. Listings, the player's inventory and history need one, see the [token API](token-api.md).

tags.name: game/items
tags.description: The item page of the social market, by skin index.

tags.name: game/social
tags.description: the social feed; a player's own posts are players.feed

tags.name: game/shop
tags.description: The shop's catalogue. The wild offer and every purchase need the player's token.

tags.name: game/matchmaker
tags.description: `https://matchmaker.krunker.io`, plain JSON without an envelope. The game polls the list every 60 seconds. krapio adds `hostname=krunker.io` to every call.

tags.name: game/legacy
tags.description: `https://api.krunker.io`, the old REST API. Only the paths the page calls without a token.

tags.name: token/player
tags.description: The token's own account.

tags.name: token/market
tags.description: The market behind a login. Market stats and item pages answer without a token, see the [game API](game-api.md#market).

tags.name: token/trades
tags.description: Player to player trades. Creating, accepting and cancelling are writes and are not in krapio.

tags.name: token/shop
tags.description: Per player shop state and the player's own custom skins.

tags.name: token/creator
tags.description: What a creator sees of their own maps and studios, plus the player's clan applications. The studio replies are untyped in krapio (`unknown`), only their existence was verified.

tags.name: token/staff
tags.description:
Role gated reads for moderators and KPD reviewers. A normal account gets a 403 `insufficient permissions` (or `not authorized` for reports). The replies are untyped in krapio, no account with the role was available to verify them.

`me.staff.chatBan(playerName)`, `.reports(playerName)`, `.kpdDemos({ off, q })`, `.kpdDemo(demoId, ct?)`, `.kpdReviewers()`

`chatBan` is a player's chat ban, `kpdDemos` the demo review queue (`off` is the offset, `q` a search), `kpdDemo` one demo where `ct` is the review ticket the game passes along.

tags.name: token/ranked
tags.description: `https://api.krunker.io`, the ranked system's own API. Every call answers 401 `Access token required` without a token, including the public leaderboard.

get.description:
Returns events newer than `after`, oldest first. Store `next` and pass it as `after` on your next call. Start with `after=0`. Keep the same filters between calls; `next` also moves past events your filters skipped, so changing filters later does not bring those back.

**Rate limit:** 6 requests per minute per key, on top of the general limit. The `X-RateLimit-*` headers on this endpoint describe this 6-per-minute limit. Poll every 20 to 60 seconds; if `has_more` is `true`, fetch the next page right away.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| after | int | query | no | Event id cursor (default 0) |
| types | string | query | no | Comma-separated event types to return (default: all your scopes allow) |
| target_type | string | query | no | Only events about this kind of target, e.g. `map` |
| target_id | string | query | no | Comma-separated target ids, up to 100 (needs `target_type`), e.g. `target_type=map&target_id=8497,8500` |
| limit | int | query | no | 1 to 100 (default 100) |

Events appear a few seconds after they happen. Ids only increase; gaps are normal.

**Event data:**

| Type | `data` fields |
| --- | --- |
| `map.featured`, `map.unfeatured` | `map_id`, `map_name`, `creator` |

parameters.description: event id cursor, the `next` of the previous page; 0 when omitted

parameters.description: only these types; everything the key's scopes allow when omitted

parameters.description: only events about this kind of target, e.g. "map"

parameters.description: only these targets, 100 at most, needs target_type

get.description:
List the 50 most recent KPD (player hacker-report) calls, newest first, across all statuses so officer verdicts are visible. Requires the `kpd` scope.

**Parameters:**

None.

**Response Fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | int | Report id |
| date | string | Call time (RFC 3339, UTC) |
| caller_id | int | Reporter player id |
| caller_name | string | Reporter name |
| caller_score | int | Reporter score |
| caller_job_rating | int | Reporter's total KPD job rating |
| caller_job_rating_positive | int | Reporter's correct (positive) call count |
| called_id | int | Reported player id |
| called_name | string | Reported player name (`guest` if unregistered) |
| called_score | int | Reported player score |
| kdf_type | int | Call context: 0=public, 1=ranked, 2=comp, 3=custom |
| kdf_type_label | string | Readable kdf_type |
| status | int | 1=not responded, 2=responded, 3=reviewed |
| status_label | string | Readable status |
| rating | int | Officer verdict: 0=pending, 1=banned, 2=rejected |
| rating_label | string | Readable rating |
| officer_id | int | Officer who handled the call (0 if none) |
| officer_name | string | Officer name |
| status_date | string | Last status change (RFC 3339, UTC) |
| game_code | string | Game instance code |
| host | string | Game server host |
| port | string | Game server port |
| token | string | Internal call token |

**Notes:**

- Player IP addresses are not exposed.
- A fixed window of the 50 most recent calls; there is no pagination.

get.description:
Retrieve map information by its name.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mapname | string | path | yes | The map's name (URL encoded) |

**Response Fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| map_id | int | Unique map identifier |
| name | string | Map name |
| description | string | Map description |
| creator_name | string | Username of the map creator |
| votes | int | Total upvotes |
| gameplays | int | Number of times the map has been played |
| playtime | int64 | Total playtime in milliseconds |
| category | int | Map category ID |
| created_at | string | When the map was created |
| updated_at | string | When the map was last updated |
| leaderboard_type | string | Type of leaderboard (e.g., "time", "score", empty if none) |
| leaderboard_order | int | Sort order for leaderboard (0 = ascending/lower is better, 1 = descending/higher is better) |
| featured | bool | *undocumented* - whether the map is currently featured |

**Notes:**

- Returns 404 if map not found or is restricted/deleted
- Map name is case-sensitive (*observed*: it is not, `burg` finds `Burg`)
- *observed*: `created_at` and `updated_at` come as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, not RFC3339

get.description:
Retrieve the leaderboard for a specific map (paginated).

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mapname | string | path | yes | The map's name (URL encoded) |
| page | int | query | no | Page number (default: 1) |
| type | string | query | no | Built-in leaderboard to rank on: `score` or `time`. Defaults to the map's configured leaderboard |
| order | int | query | no | 0 = ascending, 1 = descending. Defaults to the map's order for its configured leaderboard; otherwise ascending for `time`, descending for `score` |

**Response Fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| page | int | Current page number |
| per_page | int | Number of entries per page (25) |
| map_name | string | The map name queried |
| leaderboard_type | string | Type of leaderboard (e.g., "time", "score") |
| leaderboard_order | int | Sort order (0 = ascending, 1 = descending) |
| entries | object\[\] | Array of leaderboard entries |
| entries\[\].position | int | Leaderboard position |
| entries\[\].player_name | string | Player's username |
| entries\[\].value | int | Score or time value |
| entries\[\].date | string | When the entry was recorded |

**Notes:**

- Returns empty entries array if the map has no leaderboard configured
- Maps can show both a score and a time leaderboard in-game; use `type` (and `order`) to fetch either. Invalid values return 400
- Page size is fixed at 25 records
- Entries are sorted by value according to leaderboard_order

get.description:
Retrieve market information and active listings for a specific skin.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| skinindex | int | path | yes | The skin index (item type ID) |
| page | int | query | no | Page number for listings (default: 1) |
| days | int | query | no | Number of days for price history (default: 30, max: 120) |

**Response Fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| skin_index | int | The skin index queried |
| total_listings | int | Total number of active listings |
| lowest_price | int | Lowest listed price (0 if no listings) |
| average_price | float | Average sale price from last 7 days |
| total_circulating | int | Total quantity of this skin in circulation |
| listings | object\[\] | Paginated list of active listings (sorted by price ascending) |
| listings\[\].price | int | Listing price in KR |
| listings\[\].seller_name | string | Seller's username |
| listings\[\].listed_at | string | When the listing was created |
| owners | object\[\] | First 100 owners sorted by quantity owned (descending) |
| owners\[\].player_name | string | Owner's username |
| owners\[\].count | int | Number of this skin the player owns |
| price_history | object\[\] | Daily average sale prices for the specified time period |
| price_history\[\].date | string | Date (YYYY-MM-DD format) |
| price_history\[\].average_price | float | Average sale price on that day |
| price_history\[\].sales | int | Number of sales on that day |

**Notes:**

- Listings are sorted by price (lowest first)
- Page size is fixed at 10 records for listings
- `average_price` is calculated from sales in the last 7 days
- Owners list shows up to 100 players, sorted by quantity owned (highest first)
- Banned users are excluded from the owners list
- `price_history` contains daily averages for days with sales within the specified `days` parameter (default 30, max 120 days / 4 months)
- *observed*: this is the slow endpoint, over 10 s cold and about 3 s warm; every other endpoint answers in under a second

| objective_score | int | Player's objective score |
| kr | int | KR earned from this match |
| victory | int | Match result (1 = win, 0 = loss, -1 = draw) |
| rounds_won | int | Rounds won by player's team |
| team | int | Player's team number |
| play_time | int | Player's active play time in milliseconds |
| mmr | int | Player's MMR at the time of this match |

**Notes:**

- Only ranked matches are returned
- Page size is fixed at 10 records
- Matches are ordered by date descending
- *observed*: `matches` is `null` instead of `[]` when the page is past the end
- The `mmr` field shows the player's rating after each match, allowing you to calculate MMR changes between matches

get.description:
List all skin definitions with optional filtering.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page | int | query | no | Page number (default: 1) |
| per_page | int | query | no | Items per page (default: 100, max: 10000) |
| season | int | query | no | Season filter (returns only skins for the specified season) |

**Response Fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| page | int | Current page number |
| per_page | int | Items per page |
| total | int | Total number of matching skins |
| skins | array | Array of skin objects |
| skins\[\].index | int | Skin index (ID) |
| skins\[\].name | string | Skin name |
| skins\[\].type | int | Skin type |
| skins\[\].rarity | int | Skin rarity |
| skins\[\].weapon | int | Weapon index (omitted if null) |
| skins\[\].seas | int | *undocumented* - the skin's season; this is the field name the `season` filter refers to, there is no `season` field in the reply |
| skins\[\].thumbnail | string | *undocumented* - preview image URL |
| skins\[\].tradable | bool | *undocumented* |
| skins\[\].id | int | *undocumented* - equals `index` on `GET /api/skins/:skinid`, absent in the list |

**Notes:**

- Each skin object may contain additional properties from its configuration, merged into the root level (*observed*: `creator`, `glow`, `frames`, `frameT`, `mid`, `midT`, `pulsT`, ...)
- Use the `season` parameter to retrieve skins for a specific ranked season
- Skins without a season field are treated as season 1

GameOptions.description: the options object inside a game list entry

MarketStatRow.description: one row of GET /market/stats: skin index, in circulation, on sale, and the ask range while something is listed

Stream.description: one live stream in the menu's stream box

ItemPrices.description: GET api.krunker.io/webhooks/general/items/prices: index = skin index, null = no price

LegacyModRow.description: one row of the legacy mod browser

LegacyMapRow.description: one row of the legacy map browser

RaidLeaderboardRow.description: GET /leaderboards/raids/:mapId, 100 rows; map 31 is a raid map, 0 is not ("invalid raid map ID")

PlayerLeaderboardRow.description: one row of a player leaderboard

ItemSale.description: one day of sales of an item: kr, count, date; GET /items/:id/sales and /market/items/:id/sales-statistics

owners.description: name, count owned, staff, featured, cr

ItemView.description: GET /items/:id/view, the item page of the social market

ItemOwner.description: one of an item's top owners, short keys as the game sends them

CreatorEvents.description: GET /creators/events, the menu's event and survey box

CommunityMap.description: GET /maps/by-name/:name, the community map record (the official Burg is a different thing, see OfficialMap)

MapConfig.description: GET /maps/:id, the whole map file (120 KB for Burg), only the keys the client reads are named

OfficialMap.description: GET /maps, index = id = preview image number at assets.krunker.io/img/maps/map_<id>.png

RecruitmentPost.description: a clan's post on the recruitment board

LootDistributionMode.description: how a clan splits its turf earnings

clan_logo.description: logo version, 0 or null without one; image at user-assets.krunker.io/clans/<clan_id>.png?v=<clan_logo>

clan_banner_color.description: "s<n>" = paint shader n, otherwise a color

r.description: role: 0 recruit, 1 soldier, 2 captain, 3 commander; the creator is listed with 0

ClanPublicMember.description: one member in a public clan profile, short keys as the game sends them

weapon.description: omitted when the skin has no weapon

seas.description: the season; the docs call this field season

id.description: undocumented, equals index on the single skin endpoint

SkinDefinition.description: extra config properties of a skin (creator, glow, frames, ...) get merged into the root, so the index signature is real

PlayerPost.description: one social post of a player

matches.description: null when the page is past the end

damage_done.description: Player's damage dealt in this match

PlayerMatch.description: one ranked match from a player's point of view

skin_index.description: Identifier for the skin being sold

PlayerListing.description: one of a player's active market listings

skin_id.description: undocumented: id of the owned item, not the definition

InventoryItemMetadata.description: undocumented: kounter stats and float data of one owned skin, every field optional; shape from the community wrapper

clan.description: empty when not in a clan

badges.description: Array of badge IDs the player has earned

following.description: Number of players this player is following

followers.description: Number of players following this player

ranked.description: one entry per region with 6+ placement matches this season

class_stats.description: undocumented: class id -> score with that class

hacker_tagged.description: Whether the player has been flagged as a cheater

kpd.description: Whether the player is a KPD moderator

premium.description: Whether the player has an active premium subscription

maps.description: undocumented: maps the player voted on, only seen empty so far

mods.description: undocumented: mods the player voted on, only seen empty so far

damage_done.description: Total damage dealt in ranked matches

time_played.description: Total time played in ranked matches (seconds)

PlayerRanked.description: a player's ranked stats in one region this season

VotedItem.description: undocumented: a map or mod the player voted on, shape from the community wrapper

created_at.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", not rfc3339 like the docs say

updated_at.description: When the mod was last updated (same format)

participants.description: ordered by team, then score descending

damage_done.description: Player's damage dealt in this match

MatchParticipant.description: one player of a ranked match

total_circulating.description: Total quantity of this skin in circulation

listings.description: page of active listings, cheapest first

owners.description: up to 100, most owned first, banned users excluded

MarketListing.description: one active listing of a skin on the market

count.description: Number of this skin the player owns

MarketOwner.description: one owner in a skin's top owners

average_price.description: Average sale price on that day

sales.description: Number of sales on that day

PricePoint.description: one day of a skin's price history

LeaderboardType.description: which built in board a map has: score or time

MapLeaderboardEntry.description: one row of a map leaderboard

creator_id.description: Player id of the map creator

gameplays.description: Number of times the map has been played

created_at.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", not rfc3339 like the docs say

updated_at.description: When the map was last updated

leaderboard_type.description: "time", "score" or empty when the map has no leaderboard

leaderboard_order.description: Sort order for leaderboard (0 = ascending/lower is better, 1 = descending/higher is better)

damage_done.description: Total damage dealt in ranked matches

LeaderboardEntry.description: one row of the ranked leaderboard

next.description: pass as `after` on the next call, it also moves past events the filters skipped

id.description: only ever increases, gaps are normal

ApiEvent.description: one event of GET /api/events or of a webhook delivery

EventType.description: the types documented so far; a key only sees the types of the event scopes it holds

EventTarget.description: what an event is about, e.g. type "map" and the map id

ClanMember.description: one row of a clan's member list

member_count.description: Number of members in the clan

discord.description: discord invite code, empty when not set

EnvelopeError.description: an error reply of gapi: data is null and error carries a code and a message
